protocol.run_order: cyclic rotation and reversal across baseline, identical-binary control, candidate
protocol.hash_seeds: Production random salts; not fixed for benchmarks

timed_scope.official: whole process including I/O, compression, data structure construction and destruction
timed_scope.api: each operation timed separately after input generation

current_online_status: 未提出。ローカル時間をオンラインの時間へ換算しない。

rejected_point_specialization.reason: The get specialization improved several point queries but introduced slower set and other API conditions; the flags version is retained.

limits: Production hash salts vary between processes; identical-binary controls and repeated interleaved runs are included.
Positive median differences are kept above. They must not be hidden or treated as a guarantee that every operation is faster.
One-shot copy/clear timings at hundreds of nanoseconds are supplemented with 10000-operation repeated measurements.
No 100ms/300ms online target has been verified for this candidate.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,statistics,fcntl,shutil,sys,time,os
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;data=Path('/tmp/atcoder_verify_20261019/official/library-checker-problems-master/data_structure/point_add_rectangle_sum/in')
tags=['baseline','control',*sys.argv[2:]];label=sys.argv[1];rows=[];summaries=[]
shutil.copyfile(p/'main_baseline',p/'main_control');(p/'main_control').chmod(0o755)
with open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for case in os.environ.get('SCREEN_CASES','max_random_00,many_points_00,many_queries_00,power_of_2_00,random_01,xy_concentrate_00').split(','):
  for rep in range(-1,int(os.environ.get('SCREEN_ROUNDS','3'))):
   shift=(rep+1)%len(tags);order=tags[shift:]+tags[:shift]
   if rep%2:order=order[::-1]
   for tag in order:
    with (data/(case+'.in')).open('rb')as f:
     t=time.perf_counter_ns();run=subprocess.Popen(['taskset','-c','14',str(p/f'main_{tag}')],stdin=f,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
     _,st,u=os.wait4(run.pid,0);elapsed=time.perf_counter_ns()-t;run.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(st);err=run.stderr.read();run.stderr.close();assert not run.returncode,err
    if rep>=0:rows.append(dict(case=case,label=tag,round=rep,elapsed_ns=elapsed,peak_rss_kib=u.ru_maxrss))
  groups={k:statistics.median(r['elapsed_ns']for r in rows if r['case']==case and r['label']==k)for k in tags};s=dict(case=case,median_ms={k:v/1e6 for k,v in groups.items()},change_percent={k:100*(v/groups['baseline']-1)for k,v in groups.items()});summaries.append(s)
  print(case,{k:round(v,2)for k,v in s['median_ms'].items()},{k:round(v,1)for k,v in s['change_percent'].items()},flush=True)
  (p/f'screen_{label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(cpu=14,rounds=int(os.environ.get('SCREEN_ROUNDS','3')),warmup=1,flags='GCC15.3 C++23 O2 march=native SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS',rows=rows,summaries=summaries),indent=2))

api_screen.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,statistics,fcntl,shutil,sys,os
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
label=sys.argv[1];tags=['baseline','control',*sys.argv[2:]]
shutil.copyfile(p/'api_baseline',p/'api_control');(p/'api_control').chmod(0o755)
rows=[];summaries=[]
with open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for case in ['small','dense','moderate','tall','wide','threshold','compressed']:
  for rep in range(-1,int(os.environ.get('API_ROUNDS','3'))):
   shift=(rep+1)%len(tags);order=tags[shift:]+tags[:shift]
   if rep%2:order=order[::-1]
   for tag in order:
    r=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(p/f'api_{tag}'),case],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
    v=json.loads(r.stdout)
    if rep>=0:rows.append(dict(label=tag,round=rep,**v))
  data=[r for r in rows if r['case']==case];assert len({r['checksum']for r in data})==1 and len({r['nodes']for r in data})==1
  metrics=['add_ns','rectangle_ns','prefix_ns','get_ns','set_ns','copy_ns','refill_ns','peak_rss_kib']
  s={'case':case,'medians':{tag:{m:statistics.median(r[m]for r in data if r['label']==tag)for m in metrics}for tag in tags}}
  summaries.append(s);print(case,json.dumps(s['medians']),flush=True)
  (p/f'api_{label}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cpu':14,'compiler':'GCC15.3 -O2 C++23 -march=native -DEVAL -DONLINE_JUDGE SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS','rows':rows,'summaries':summaries},indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,statistics,fcntl,shutil,sys,os
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;core=p/'core';label=sys.argv[1];tags=['baseline','control',sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'hot'];rows=[];summaries=[]
shutil.copyfile(core/'copy_refill_baseline',core/'copy_refill_control');(core/'copy_refill_control').chmod(0o755)
with open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for width in [4096,1000000]:
  for points in [1,8,32,64,128]:
   for rep in range(-1,7):
    shift=(rep+1)%len(tags);order=tags[shift:]+tags[:shift]
    if rep%2:order=order[::-1]
    for tag in order:
     run=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(core/f'copy_refill_{tag}'),str(points),str(width)],capture_output=True,text=True);assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr
     value=json.loads(run.stdout)
     if rep>=0:rows.append((value | dict(width=width,points=points,label=tag,round=rep)))
   data=[r for r in rows if r['width']==width and r['points']==points]
   assert len({r['copy_checksum'] for r in data})==1 and len({r['nodes'] for r in data})==1
   s=dict(width=width,points=points,medians={tag:{m:statistics.median(r[m] for r in data if r['label']==tag)for m in ['copy_ms','clear_refill_ms']}for tag in tags});summaries.append(s);print(json.dumps(s),flush=True)
   (p/f'copy_refill_{label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(cpu=14,rounds=7,warmup=1,rows=rows,summaries=summaries),indent=2))
